name: Alexander Volkov
summary: Veteran 6'7" heavyweight kickboxer (40-11), 6-1 in his last seven with the only loss a split decision to Ciryl Gane. Fights long behind the jab and kicks; once a first-round finisher, he has gone the distance in his last four fights.

how_they_fight.Striking: Range management: jab, inside and outside leg kicks, body and head kicks, straight right (Cageside on Cortes-Acosta). About 5.3 significant strikes a minute at 58%. Landed 88 significant strikes vs Cortes-Acosta and closed his eye.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Not a wrestler (0.7 takedowns per 15). Gave up seven takedowns and over 10 minutes of control to Jailton Almeida but kept getting up, reversing, landing elbows and threatening a triangle; won a split decision (Cageside, Rotowire). Submitted Tuivasa (R2, 2023).
how_they_fight.Defense: About 69% takedown defence; can be taken down but rarely kept there for damage. Stopped five times: subs in R1 twice early in his career and by Tom Aspinall (R1, 2022), KO by Vitaly Minakov (R1, 2013) and Derrick Lewis (R3 at 4:49, 2018). Was bloodied and pressured late by Cortes-Acosta.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Was a fast starter: 17 of his 28 finishes came in R1, 8 in R2, 2 in R3 and 1 in R4 (verified). Recently a decision fighter: Pavlovich, Gane (L), Almeida and Cortes-Acosta all went three rounds; last finish Tuivasa (R2, Sept 2023). Lets opponents rally late (Cortes-Acosta's third round, Lewis's late KO).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient and disciplined at range; manages risk well but can coast after banking rounds.

patterns: Jab and kicks at range; leg kicks early
Wins the first two rounds, survives a late push
Recent wins on the cards, not by finish
concerns: Late-round surges from heavy hitters (Lewis KO R3, Cortes-Acosta R3)
Age (38) and a run of close decisions
keys_to_beat: Close distance and clinch against the fence

news.text: Made weight at the official weigh-ins: 256 lb (Kuniev 265).
Sherdog preview: -120 favourite (Kuniev +100); expects his height and movement to keep Kuniev at range and picks him by decision.
UFC.com Fight By Fight Preview frames it as a possible title eliminator, and a trap fight for him given his ranking.
Called Josh Hokit 'the easiest title shot' and is rooting for Hokit to beat Ciryl Gane.
Volkov vs Kuniev described as a heavyweight title eliminator (per AgentMMA, which noted it was not yet official then).
